author: Gixx3
quote: Welcome to “Behave Yourself GTA,” where you’re supposed to be an upstanding citizen. No more stealing, no more killing. Just go to church on Sundays. In this woke version of GTA, you won’t be able to go berserk like you could in the older games. It didn’t grab my attention at **** can’t steal anything without having to change your clothes, your phone number, and your home address, and even get plastic surgery just to lose the cops. You can’t hit people with bats or throw things at them. You won’t even be able to flip cars.They’ve ruined the franchise, and the graphics aren’t nearly good enough to justify all the hype.
